newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ryoden in HK$372 mln new share issue.
newsitem.headline: Ryoden in HK$372 mln new share issue.

text.p: Ryoden Development Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to issue 180 million new shares at HK$2.10 to major shareholder Designcase Ltd to raise HK$372 million after expenses.

Designcase, controlled by Ryoden chairman Hu Fa-kuang's family, has conditionally agreed to subscribe to the new shares after it agreed to place 108 million existing Ryoden shares to private investors at the same price, Ryoden said in a statement.
Jardine Fleming Securities and Goodwill Investment Services Ltd are placing agents for Designcase.
Ryoden, a property investor and developer, said the placing and issue price represented a discount of about 7.69 percent to the shares' Tuesday close of HK$2.275 per share.

The Hu family and its associates' interest in the company would be diluted to 67.26 percent of Ryoden's enlarged issued share capital after the deals from the existing 72.79 percent in total, it added.

About HK$280 million of the proceeds would be used to finance its recent property acquisitions in Hong Kong and the remaining HK$92 million for future property acquisitions and as general working capital, the company said.
